    Description
    ErrorResponse
    Response sent by the server when a client request is rejected or an internal error occurs.
    EventsTriggered
    Sent by the server once per resolved end-of-round event, immediately after the event's effect has been applied.
    GameEnded
    Response broadcast to all players when a game ends.
    GameLogRestore
    Sent to a single client when it (re)joins a game in progress, carrying the full game-log transcript accumulated server-side.
    GameUpdate
    Response sent after every game-state change.
    HomeUpdate
    Response sent to clients on the home screen when the list of open games changes.
    LobbyUpdate
    Response sent when the lobby roster changes.
    LoginNeeded
    Response sent immediately after a client connects (or after logout) to signal that it must authenticate with a LoginRequest before any other request is accepted.
    ResponseVisitor
    Visitor interface for dispatching ServerResponse subtypes on the client side without instanceof checks.
    ServerDisconnected
    Response sent by the server to notify the client that it has been forcefully disconnected (e.g. timeout or shutdown).
    ServerPing
    Keep-alive response sent by the server in reply to a ClientPing.

    TotemAvailableUpdate
    Response sent during the totem-picking phase after each player picks a totem, broadcasting the updated list of totems still available for selection.
